comment: P2-1/P2-2 scheme jurisdiction exceptions. Explicit, inspectable data for national schemes with known state opt-out behavior. Research grounding: Gujarat suspended PMFBY from Kharif 2020 (state-funded MMKSY/relief architecture instead). Effect is DEMOTION-ONLY on matching ladder-type content for the opt-out state; instruments are never demoted and other jurisdictions never affected. PMFBY is therefore never globally treated as Gujarat insurance.

exceptions.effect: demote national ladder-type content when Gujarat relief architecture applies AND Gujarat relief/instrument evidence is present in the pool (conditional preference, never blind suppression)
exceptions.evidence: deep-research report findings 2 (PMFBY 25 States/UTs Kharif 2026; Gujarat suspension + MMKSY launch)
exceptions.subject: crop_insurance

comment_assumed: P2-2: when state is merely assumed (not explicit) on these subjects, geo and mandate-fit influence halve. Explicit state keeps full weight. Branches are preserved, never removed.
